description: Wasserleitungsnetz der Westfalen Weser Netz GmbH (WWN) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The supply network comprises geodata for the "water" - distribution network and transport network division within the network area. Included are the water networks of Stadtwerke Lage and Stadtoldendorf, because the operation and documentation of the networks is carried out by Westfalen Weser GmbH. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply network of Westfalen Weser Netz GmbH (WWN)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
